name: Clean-up icon follows focus and clears the "Опис" field
description:
Admins can create team member categories
  and get validation feedback while filling in the category form.
descriptionHtml:
Admins can create team member categories
and get validation feedback while filling in the category form.

testStage.description:
Admins can create team member categories
  and get validation feedback while filling in the category form.

steps.name: Given the admin is logged in
And the admin opens the Team page
And the admin opens the Add category modal
Open Team category context menu
Open the add Team category dialog
When the admin clicks inside the "Опис" field
Click inside the 'Опис' field
Then the clean-up icon is not displayed in the "Опис" field
Check clean-up icon is hidden in the 'Опис' field
When the admin enters "Volunteers" into the "Опис" field
Enter Team category description
Then the clean-up icon is displayed in the "Опис" field
Check clean-up icon is shown in the 'Опис' field
When the admin clicks outside the field
Leave the 'Опис' field
Then the clean-up icon is not displayed in the "Опис" field
Check clean-up icon is hidden in the 'Опис' field
When the admin clicks inside the "Опис" field
Click inside the 'Опис' field
Then the clean-up icon is displayed in the "Опис" field
Check clean-up icon is shown in the 'Опис' field
When the admin clicks the clean-up icon in the "Опис" field
Click the clean-up icon in the 'Опис' field
Then the "Опис" field is empty
And the "Опис" character counter shows "0/200"
